input.stem: The first-order gas-phase thermal decomposition of di-tert-butyl peroxide into acetone and ethane is carried out in a closed vessel at constant volume. At a temperature of 500.0 K, the initial concentration of 0.04 mol L⁻¹ decreases to a concentration of 0.01 mol L⁻¹ after a time elapsed of 1800.0 s. At a temperature of 520.0 K, the decomposition exhibits a rate constant of 0.00281 s⁻¹. Given R = 8.314 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹, calculate the fraction of molecules with energy ≥ E_a at a temperature of 650.0 K.
